units.source_text: 这时候源氏公子心中只管怀念着一个人。

en.t: At this time, Prince Genji could think only of one person in his heart.

units.source_text: 他想：“这个人没有一点不足之处，也没有一点越分之处，真是十全其美。”

en.t: He thought, "This person has not the slightest flaw, nor the slightest excess; she is truly perfect in every way."

units.source_text: 不胜爱慕之情，胸怀为之郁结。

en.t: Overcome by longing and admiration, his heart grew heavy and troubled because of it.
